description: PHP class parser for modifying layout views in SuiteCRM, handling layout parsing, field management, file I/O, and cache clearing.

classes.name: ParserModifyLayoutView
classes.description: A parser class for modifying and managing layout views within SuiteCRM, including loading, editing, and saving layout definitions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the parser with module, view, and optional submitted layout.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Returns fields available for layout, excluding those already used.

methods.name: writeWorkingFile
methods.description: Writes the current view definition to the working file.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current layout to the custom directory and clears the cache.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Loads layout definitions for a specified module and view.

methods.name: _loadLayoutFromRequest
methods.description: Loads layout configuration from submitted form data.

methods.name: _padFields
methods.description: Ensures layout panels are padded with empty fields to match max columns.

methods.name: _addField
methods.description: Adds a new field to a specified panel in the layout.

methods.name: _getModelFields
methods.description: Retrieves all model fields for the current module, including original layout fields.

methods.name: _parseData
methods.description: Parses layout panel data into display-friendly format.

methods.name: _getOrigFieldViewDefs
methods.description: Loads and returns original field view definitions from the layout source file.
